Thank you for helping to improve Freetz-EVO. Before opening a bug report,
please check the [documentation](https://ircama.github.io/freetz-evo/) and
[open discussions](https://github.com/Ircama/freetz-evo/discussions) to make
sure your issue has not already been reported or solved.

## What happened?

Describe the problem in a clear and concise way.

## Steps to reproduce

1. ...
2. ...
3. ...

## Expected behavior

What did you expect to happen instead?

## Actual behavior

What actually happened? **"Error 1" alone is not a valid description** — please
quote the relevant log lines.

## Environment

- Device / model: (e.g. FRITZ!Box 7590 AX)
- Firmware version and series: (e.g. 08_2X, Freetz-EVO 30460M)
- Build configuration: attach your `.config` (rename it to `config.txt` if
  GitHub refuses the file type)
- Toolchain / uClibc / kernel: (if relevant)

## Logs

Attach the relevant logs — in most cases more than 10 lines are needed. Format
code and logs by wrapping them in triple backticks:

```text
your log output here
```

If your log file uses an extension GitHub does not accept, append `.txt`.

## Screenshots

If applicable, embed screenshots by dragging them into this text box.

## Additional context

Anything else that could help (e.g. storage layout, installed packages,
external device, swap configuration, previous attempt with the same setup).
